$comment: Content-script budget from docs/tech-stack.md section 6 (the observer and the card are unlisted scripts built to observer.js and explain-card.js at the package root) (D-08, raised to 18 KB by D-20). KB means 1024 bytes. Sizes are gzip level 9 of the built file. The toolbar (Preact) is injected on the first selection with its own 18 KB gzip budget; the explanation card loads separately (Phase 5) with its own budget: it carries its own Preact copy, the card styles and the session logic, and must stay free of zod and React. Reader budgets (Phase 7): the reader page loads reader-page-js at start, reader-lazy-ui on the first selection/Explain, pdfjs-js on the first opened file, pdfjs-data files on demand. Hashed chunk names come from the bundler; patterns match by prefix. maxZipBytes (3.2 MB) caps the store ZIP and maxUnpackedBytes (7 MiB; the 1.0.0 build unpacks to 5.2 MiB) caps the sum of its entries; both are enforced by scripts/audit-zip.mjs after `npm run zip`.

budgets.description: Always-loaded selection observer; UI is injected separately on demand
Preact toolbar and artwork, injected only for the first qualifying selection
Explanation card, injected on the first Explain (Phase 5, D-08); not part of the observer
PDF reader page JavaScript loaded at start (shell, React, selection controller, Listen); excludes PDF.js and the lazily loaded toolbar/card

Side panel page JavaScript (Phase 8, FR-042): the React shell, the shared React chunk (the chunk that holds react and react-dom, whatever the bundler names it), the zod contracts used to validate the hand-off, the shared session logic and Listen. Loaded only when the user opens the panel
Toolbar (Preact) and explanation card, loaded by the reader on the first selection and the first Explain
PDF.js core, viewer components and worker, loaded when the first PDF is opened
PDF.js runtime data (CMaps, standard fonts, ICC profiles, wasm decoders), fetched on demand; sum of per-file gzip
Reader stylesheet (PDF.js viewer CSS plus the shell)
